title: apichap AI Coding Gateway rule file
description: Allow and deny rules for Claude Code tool calls. A matching deny rule always wins; calls no allow rule covers become approval requests.

version.description: Version of this rule set. For the default rules, a higher version makes the dashboard offer the update.

exportedAt.description: Set by export. Ignored on import.

allow.description: Rules that let tool calls through.

deny.description: Rules that block tool calls. They always win over allow rules.

rule.description: Tool or Tool(pattern), e.g. Read, Shell(git *), FileEdit({cwd}/**), mcp__github__*. Wildcards: * anything, ? one character; in paths * stays in a folder and ** crosses folders. Groups: Shell = Bash + PowerShell, FileEdit = Edit, Write, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit, File = Read + FileEdit.

note.description: Why the rule exists. For deny rules, this is what Claude and the user see when the rule blocks a call.

enabled.description: Set to false to keep the rule but switch it off.
